name: dnf
description: The modern package manager of Fedora, RHEL 8+, CentOS Stream, Rocky, and AlmaLinux — the successor to yum with the same command surface.

flags.description: Install / remove packages with dependency resolution.
Apply available updates (upgrade is the preferred alias).
Which package provides this file or capability?
Show past transactions — the base for undo/rollback.

examples.explanation: Applies all available updates (RHEL-family equivalent of apt upgrade).
Finds which package supplies a missing command: the answer here is net-tools.
Lists transactions with IDs; sudo dnf history undo 42 reverts transaction 42 — a capability apt lacks.

about: dnf resolves dependencies via libsolv, supports Python plugins, and keeps a transaction history enabling undo/rollback. yum still exists as a symlink to dnf on modern releases, so old yum documentation remains valid.
useCases: Finding packages that provide missing files.
Rolling back a bad update with history undo.
mistakes: Looking for yum documentation on RHEL 8+ — dnf replaced it (yum is an alias).
distroNotes: Fedora, RHEL 8+, CentOS Stream, Rocky, AlmaLinux. RHEL 7 and older use yum.
